source_record.prompt: Make a bounded wardrobe edit to the supplied accepted historical illustration. Preserve every recognizable face, apparent age, eye color, gaze, expression, facial anatomy, natural body fullness, hand and finger positions, action, composition, room and light. Do not slim Emma, change pregnancy/postpartum appearance, or replace anyone with a new actor. The supplied master-derived face is identity evidence, not an instruction to copy one later outfit into every year. Change only the specified clothes and arranged hair; preserve hair color and hairline exactly. Clothing is a researched period-plausible interpretation, not a claim the named people personally owned these precise garments. Natural photographic cloth and folds, no fashion-magazine styling, modern fasteners or modern hat. No text or new scene props. Preserve original input; this replacement does not add a second original count. Autumn1828, Joseph22 and Emma24. Preserve exact comb handoff, hands and accepted faces. Emma wears a warm russet-brown cotton day dress with a small restrained print, raised waist and1820s sleeves moderately full above, narrowing toward wrist, simple modest neckline; replace elaborate lace/brooch and copied blue formal outfit. Same dark hair gathered at back with softly arranged side sections. Do not create a late-pregnancy bulge or reduce her natural build. Joseph wears a muted earthy waistcoat over his existing plain work shirt, with a worn charcoal-brown practical outer coat rather than a formal black suit. Keep held hat and all props as already present.
source_record.source_limits: Period garment categories/forms only; exact individual colors, cloth, hairstyle and possession not documented. Garment references do not authorize body measurement claims.

normalization: Final placement id mapped to exact prompt/final bytes; source decision preserved, no new broader concurrence.
